fun plan() {
  val planTools = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val committedPlan = compute(input = planTools)
  val taskContext = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val evidence = compute(plan = committedPlan, context = taskContext)
  val evidenceFile = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = evidence)
  val noopSignal = publish(channel = "safeoutputs.noop", body = "No action needed: consolidated preflight evidence was written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json; no GitHub issue or comment was requested.")
}
